---
title: "Bluefin Tuna Spawning Region (BLOOFINZ)"
---

In the bluefin tuna spawning region of the Indian Ocean, I’m interested in how mixotrophy and zooplankton dynamics shape energy transfer through the food web.

Focus areas:
- The role of mixotrophic protists and their impact on apparent trophic position
- How zooplankton biomass and traits structure potential prey fields for bluefin tuna larvae
- How biogeochemistry and physical structure (fronts, eddies) interact with community composition

Methods include:
- Bulk and compound-specific isotope analyses
- Zooplankton community composition and size structure
- Conceptual and trait-based food web models
